messages:
Oliver Park: hey all — Oliver here, joined Platform today! remote in TO, usually online 9-5 ET. into late-night noodle hunts and terrible puns :ramen::laughing:
Maeve Liu: welcome Oliver!! if youre ever craving ramen, shout — we do a weekly noodle run on Wed at 12:30 :ramen::point_right:
Oliver Park: sold. also question — wheres the best place to stash a small ukulele when Im in the office? :ukulele:
Barnaby Cole: welcome! theres a lockable cubby near bench C, leave a note at People Ops and theyll set you up with a temporary key :lock::package:
Iris Koh: FYI badge pickup is at the front desk after 10am. bring your ID. also rooftop plants are fair game for repotting if youre feeling generous :seedling::sunny:
onboarding-bot: Welcome Oliver! A buddy (Maeve Liu) has been assigned and a "New Hire Welcome" event is on your calendar at 11:00. Check DMs for onboarding steps. :robot_face:
Oliver Park: got the invite, thanks bot. quick poll: who wants to join the noodle run on Wed? :ramen: = yes, :no_entry_sign: = no
Maeve Liu: :ramen: definitely — meet at elevator B at 12:25
Barnaby Cole: :ramen: Im in if someone brings chili oil
Iris Koh: :no_entry_sign: Im on calls, but bring back a napkin for me :pleading_face:
Oliver Park: noted. also pro tip request: best coffee order for surviving deployment window? :coffee:
Maeve Liu: double americano, ask for it extra hot and an encouraging compliment from the barista :thumbsup:
